speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

Given your age and the classic triad of new-onset headache with progressive vision loss, I suspect an inflammatory condition of the temporal arteries. Please describe the exact location of your pain (e.g., temple, forehead) and whether you have noticed any jaw fatigue when chewing or scalp tenderness. Immediately after you answer, I will request an ESR and CRP blood test to confirm inflammation.
